# Stop Kriptovalidáció

> Hungarian documentation site tracking the timeline of cryptocurrency "validation" law changes, exchange impacts, and affected Members of Parliament. Available in Hungarian and English.

The site documents how Hungary's crypto validation law affected cryptocurrency exchanges operating in Hungary and tracks the positions of Members of Parliament who voted on the legislation.

## Main Pages

- [Főoldal / Home](https://stopkriptovalidacio.hu/): Timeline of regulatory events, exchange status tracker, and MP directory
- [Kriptovalidálás](https://stopkriptovalidacio.hu/kriptovalidalas): Detailed explanation of the crypto validation law and its implications
- [Rólunk / About](https://stopkriptovalidacio.hu/rolunk): About the project, privacy policy, and contact information

## Data

- [Sitemap](https://stopkriptovalidacio.hu/sitemap.xml): Full sitemap
